# AFT status command samples

These five samples were generated by `subc::user_commands::tests::user_commands_samples`
from revision `75b22b343e10020aacc91081112493b7ba8c5263`, before upgrading the Rust
subc SDK and user-commands role crate. The test pins their published JSON bytes
and the equivalent compact response bodies sent to apps.

The command remains read-only and session-subject only. These samples do not
introduce project/workspace subjects or the `failed` fact state.
